adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, lines 72-91 show that Salesforce's token refresh is implemented by directly calling fetch to 'https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token' without using the refreshOAuthTokens wrapper that other integrations use. Comparing to other calendar services in the diff (Google, Office365, Lark, Zoho, etc.), they all wrap their refresh calls with refreshOAuthTokens() which checks APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and routes to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT when configured. Salesforce is missing this wrapper, meaning credential sync won't work for Salesforce as it does for other integrations. This is a real inconsistency/bug in the implementation.
